_doc: Tile types (PLAN.md 4.2). Stats are for a Large tile; hp, shield, mass scale by size_stat_factor, cost by size_cost_factor. Armor is a per-hit reduction and does NOT scale with size. Costs must come out whole at every size. Owner, 2026-10-26: prices x10 from the first pass ("you need to work for your upgrades"); economy.json says what a unit is worth in GC.

build._doc: PLAN.md 4.1: a ship fits in a 16 x 16 U square and has at most 150 tiles (the performance budget).

core._doc: Exactly one per ship (D7). Its facing is the ship's forward.

hardpoint._doc: Thrusters and edge weapons on its edges, a turret on its face.
